title: Add discrete option selection to conversation input

summary.goal: Add discrete option selection to the conversation input area for direct AI questions.

acceptance_criteria.description: MultipleChoiceInput component renders above ConversationInput when AI message has metadata.choices
Max ~4 text options displayed, styled as text (not chunky buttons)
Last option is always freeform ('or type your own')
Clicking an option sends it as a user message
Component renders nothing when no pending choices exist
Dashboard-level and project-level questions both use this pattern

observations: This is a new component — neither ideation-ui nor planner-ui has it.
The pattern is simple: AI messages can include a choices array in metadata. When present, the input area shows clickable text options.
Styled minimally, consistent with text-first aesthetic.
Selection sends as regular user message.
The status bar bubble system handles agent blocking questions separately.

steps.title: Create MultipleChoiceInput component
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/conversation/MultipleChoiceInput.tsx. Renders above ConversationInput when AI message has metadata.choices array. Display max ~4 text-styled options (not chunky buttons). Last option is freeform fallback ('or type your own'). Clicking option sends as user message, options disappear. Renders nothing when no choices.

steps.title: Wire to AI message metadata
steps.description: In ConversationPane: detect latest AI message with metadata.choices. Pass choices to MultipleChoiceInput. On option selection, call sendMessage with selected text, clear choices state. Support both dashboard-level and project-level questions.

architect.interaction: click sends as user message, options disappear
